verdict.rationale: Mistral Document AI is presented purely as an API/OCR processing capability (endpoints for OCR, annotation, QnA) with no evidence of a distinct standalone UI/console for document processing whose features would need to be mirrored via API — the evidence pack contains only API docs and community API testing, no UI screenshots or console feature descriptions. Since there's no separate UI surface evidenced, the API-vs-UI parity question doesn't meaningfully apply to this product.
